name: Pisander of Rhodes
bio: Pisander of Rhodes is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 3rd century BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 304).

poems.title: Book VII, 304
poems.author: Pisander of Rhodes
poems.text: The man’s name was Hippaemon, the horse’s Podargos, the dog’s Lethargos, and the serving-man’s Babes, a Thessalian, from Crete, of Magnesian race, the son of Haemon. He perished fighting in the front ranks. Much fun was made of it in Antiquity, as the complicated description of the ‘état civil” of Hippaemon was maliciously interpreted as comprising the “état civil” of the animals.
